lines.text: Which holds a million Earths? They look like twins.
lines.phonemes: wˌɪtʃ hˈoʊldz ɐ mˈɪliən ˈɜːθs? ðeɪ lˈʊk lˈaɪk twˈɪnz.

lines.text: In your sky, the Sun and the full Moon look the same size. But one is about four hundred times wider, and four hundred times farther away.
lines.phonemes: ɪn jʊɹ skˈaɪ, ðə sˈʌn ænd ðə fˈʊl mˈuːn lˈʊk ðə sˈeɪm sˈaɪz. bˌʌt wˈʌn ɪz ɐbˌaʊt fˈɔːɹ hˈʌndɹɪd tˈaɪmz wˈaɪdɚ, ænd fˈɔːɹ hˈʌndɹɪd tˈaɪmz fˈɑːɹðɚɹ ɐwˈeɪ.

lines.text: Line Earths up across the Sun's face: a hundred and nine. Your whole world would fit inside one big sunspot.
lines.phonemes: lˈaɪn ˈɜːθs ˌʌp əkɹˌɑːs ðə sˈʌnz fˈeɪs: ɐ hˈʌndɹɪd ænd nˈaɪn. jʊɹ hˈoʊl wˈɜːld wʊd fˈɪt ɪnsˈaɪd wˈʌn bˈɪɡ sˈʌnspɑːt.

lines.text: Nearly twenty-five centuries ago, in Athens, Anaxagoras said the Sun was a fiery stone, bigger than southern Greece. Calling it a stone, not a god, got him charged with impiety. Bigger, yes. By a factor of about seven thousand.
lines.phonemes: nˌɪɹli twˈɛntifˈaɪv sˈɛntʃɚɹiz ɐɡˈoʊ, ɪn ˈæθᵻnz, ˌænəksˈæɡəɹəs sˈɛd ðə sˈʌn wʌzɐ fˈaɪɚɹi stˈoʊn, bˈɪɡɚ ðɐn sˈʌðɚn ɡɹˈiːs. kˈɔːlɪŋ ɪɾ ɐ stˈoʊn, nˌɑːɾə ɡˈɑːd, ɡɑːt hˌɪm tʃˈɑːɹdʒd wɪð ɪmpˈaɪəɾi. bˈɪɡɚ, jˈɛs. baɪ ɐ fˈæktɚɹ ʌv ɐbˌaʊt sˈɛvən θˈaʊzənd.

lines.text: Melt down one point three million Earths, and they'd fill it. Yet among the stars, it's no giant. Some are more than a thousand times wider.
lines.phonemes: mˈɛlt dˌaʊn wˈʌn pˈɔɪnt θɹˈiː mˈɪliən ˈɜːθs, ænd ðeɪd fˈɪl ɪt. jˈɛt ɐmˌʌŋ ðə stˈɑːɹz, ɪts nˈoʊ dʒˈaɪənt. sˌʌm ɑːɹ mˈɔːɹ ðˌænə θˈaʊzənd tˈaɪmz wˈaɪdɚ.

lines.text: Astronomers even file the Sun under dwarf stars. Out there, this is what ordinary looks like.
lines.phonemes: ɐstɹˈɑːnəmɚz ˈiːvən fˈaɪl ðə sˈʌn ˌʌndɚ dwˈɔːɹf stˈɑːɹz. ˈaʊt ðˈɛɹ, ðɪs ɪz wʌt ˈɔːɹdɪnˌɛɹi lˈʊks lˈaɪk.

lines.text: Light time, across the Sun: about five seconds. Sun to Earth: eight minutes, twenty seconds.
lines.phonemes: lˈaɪt tˈaɪm, əkɹˌɑːs ðə sˈʌn: ɐbˌaʊt fˈaɪv sˈɛkəndz. sˈʌn tʊ ˈɜːθ: ˈeɪt mˈɪnɪts, twˈɛnti sˈɛkəndz.

lines.text: Next: since this started, you've flown at least two thousand kilometers. How?
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: sˈɪns ðɪs stˈɑːɹɾᵻd, juːv flˈoʊn æt lˈiːst tˈuː θˈaʊzənd kɪlˈɑːmɪɾɚz. hˈaʊ?
